        """
        Initialize a CacheItem.
        
        Args:

            ttl: Time-to-live in seconds. If None, the item never expires.
        """
        self.value = value
        self.created_at = time.time()
        self.ttl = ttl

        """
        Check if the cache item has expired based on its TTL.
        
        Returns:
            True if the item has expired, False otherwise.

            return None
        remaining = self.ttl - (time.time() - self.created_at)
